title: 2026 上海马拉松官方路线图与起终点平面图
claims: The 2026 official course map is published on the event page as a 5686x7885 JPEG at https://media.shang-ma.com/bms/5Inp4haCyXKZme35.jpg.
The 2026 course map marks the start at 06:45, the finish at 13:30, and cut-off times at 5 km 08:10, 10 km 08:50, 15 km 09:35, 20 km 10:20, 25 km 11:00, 30 km 11:45, 35 km 12:30 and 40 km 13:15.
The 2026 course map includes an altitude profile with a vertical axis labelled 5-20 m and a horizontal axis 0-42 km, but it does not label cumulative ascent or cumulative descent.

The event page also publishes a start diagram at https://media.shang-ma.com/bms/BgGqHh8WwOj6DXm4.jpg (3088x2666) and a finish diagram at https://media.shang-ma.com/bms/UwE41cYHn6PpsgNR.jpg (3088x2666).
The start diagram marks corrals A-E along the Bund and the finish diagram marks the athlete flow and bag tents inside Xujiahui Sports Park.
The official map and diagrams are published without a redistributable licence; this page links to them but does not copy or repackage the image files.

verification.checkedVia: Playwright 打开 eventId=232 赛事详情页，逐个点击“赛事路线图/起点示意图/终点示意图”标签；下载原图并用 System.Drawing 核对尺寸

claimVerification.note: Playwright 点击“赛事路线图”后出现 img src=https://media.shang-ma.com/bms/5Inp4haCyXKZme35.jpg，naturalWidth 5686、naturalHeight 7885；下载后字节数 4,434,620。
路线图右下角剖面纵轴标 5、10、15、20，横轴 0–42；图内没有累计爬升/下降数值。
点击“起点示意图”得到 3088×2666 图，点击“终点示意图”得到 3088×2666 图；两图 URL 与字节数已记入 verification.note。
起点图图例列出 A–E 区集结、存衣车、厕所等；终点图图例列出运动员流线、存衣包帐篷、医疗点、赞助商展示与徐家汇体育公园出入口。
赛事页未给图片许可声明；本页只记 URL 与事实，不把原图复制进站点媒体目录。
